title: Manyhands JSON v1 key deletion preview
description: The data of a prepare envelope that gives a preview of key delete: what the deletion will do, and the confirmation an execute of the same command and key presents to do it. A prepare that gives no preview carries no preview data: a rejection, as for a key that is selected, that Manyhands did not generate or that is not registered.

confirmation_id.description: What an execute presents as its consent. It is accepted by one request.

expires_at.description: When the confirmation stops being accepted by a new request: ten minutes after the preview. A request that has accepted it is honored afterwards.

command.description: The command the confirmation is for, as an envelope names it.

effects.description: What the command will do, in the order it does it.

details.description: The key that will be deleted and its files, as the key list gives them. It holds no key material.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint the key's registration stores.

private_key_path.description: The private key file that will be deleted.

public_key_path.description: The public key file that will be deleted.
